svg.text: Short: the right word is the first candidate, the language's input methods weighted equally. Long: the whole sentence right.
Simplified Chinese, English: end to end in Zhiyi IME's engine (every third row of the new word-choice test set; long = long
input), with ng1017 and the composition head's sentences (as above). Traditional Chinese (pinyin, two Zhuyin engines,
Jyutping, Cangjie 5/3, Quick 5/3), Japanese (Mozc conversion, prediction, whole sentence), Korean (completion), Vietnamese
(no diacritics, first letters): the int8 model ranking other IME engines' candidates, 3000 rows per test file; Traditional
and Japanese with ngram-ml-1024's n-grams (even rows).
Long for Traditional and Japanese: the composition head writes the whole sentence from the typed pinyin / Zhuyin / Jyutping /
kana (no candidates, no n-gram), 3000 rows each.
